items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My brother Michael is two years younger than me. He’s a Baptist minister in Boston at a very famous church, the Twelth Baptist.

ctx.x: Pretty short-lived, in Europe. You mentioned your brother.

My brother Michael, yeah. My brother Michael is two years younger than me. He’s a Baptist minister in Boston at a very famous church, the Twelth Baptist. In fact that’s where Martin Luther, when he went to school in Boston, I think they used to go there. He and his wife had met. In fact he did the funeral for . . .
